tool.name: Opik
tool.description: Open-source platform to trace, evaluate and monitor LLM apps, RAG systems and agents, with LLM-as-a-judge metrics and prompt optimization.
strengths: PyTest integration for LLM CI checks
Python and TypeScript SDKs plus OpenTelemetry
tool.pricing: Open source is free. Cloud: Free $0 (25k spans/month, 10 members), Pro $19/month (100k spans/month), Enterprise custom.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.practitionerNote: The Apache 2.0 license makes self-hosting low-risk, but self-hosted Opik lacks user management, so plan for network-level access control. Comet's docs describe the Docker install as not production-ready and point to Kubernetes/Helm for production.

dataResidency.detail: Self-hosting on Kubernetes keeps data in the operator's infrastructure. Comet Cloud regions are not stated on the pages reviewed.

deployment.detail: Comet-hosted cloud, local Docker Compose (not production-ready), or production Kubernetes/Helm.

auditLogging.detail: The pages reviewed do not describe audit logs, and self-hosted Opik ships without user management.

soc2.detail: Comet lists SOC 2 Type 2 on its Trust Center, covering the Comet-hosted service. Self-hosted instances rely on the operator's controls.

iso27001.detail: Comet lists ISO/IEC 27001:2022 on its Trust Center (company and hosted service). Not applicable to self-hosted instances.

iso42001.detail: The Comet Trust Center lists ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 but not ISO 42001.

euAiAct.detail: Observability and evaluation tooling, not an AI system placed on the market. Obligations rest with the deployer.

licenseRisk.detail: Apache 2.0. The README says the server, web app and core observability and evaluation can be self-hosted without a commercial license.
